findings.changed_source_surface: The inline unclosed-XML tokenization branch is in the package's source parser export, not in the /core or /wire surfaces consumed by this extension.
findings.reachability: RenderBlockView consumes render-block envelopes and reconstructs values using /core; conversation copying also uses /core. The extension imports no /source parser entry point and no tokenizer symbol.
findings.acceptance_gap: A visible hosted Chat or render_block case cannot be claimed to test this tokenizer behavior through the extension's current package imports. An XML-shaped string in chat text would not prove the changed source parser was called.
findings.future_requirement: First establish a production extension caller of the package's source parser, or a server-produced render-block contract that demonstrably routes through it. Then create a deterministic visible fixture that distinguishes trailing same-line prose from a captured XML island.

findings.reachability: No imports or use of the shared Tile component or its dimmed prop exist under extension src/. The similarly named ImageTile is local scrape/screenshot code.
findings.acceptance_gap: There is no extension consumer path where this shared Tile state can be observed. Testing it would require adding a new feature or a test-only rendering surface, neither of which accepts existing extension behavior.

independent_peer_review.finding: Extension consumes @ai-matrx/content-ir /core and /wire only; no /source tokenizer or shared Tile/dimmed consumer was found under src/.
